milestones.title: Foundation and discovery
milestones.delivered: Published articles, topic browsing, site search, reading lists and timeline. Explore filters, sorting and search have automated regression coverage.
milestones.next: Maintain navigation, accessibility and source links.

milestones.title: Unified site-wide navigation
milestones.delivered: Unified desktop and mobile navigation, accessible keyboard and touch menus, balanced dropdowns and functioning Explore category filters.
milestones.next: Check Safari, touch, keyboard and screen-reader behaviour on real devices.

milestones.title: Biblical primary-text collection
milestones.delivered: Local Bible reader, reference index and 26 original guides with linked passages.
milestones.next: Expand source-specific Biblical comparisons and review uncertain identifications.

milestones.title: Encyclopaedia expansion and preservation
milestones.delivered: Expanded historical, language, heritage and Biblical guides, including substantive Middle Assyrian studies, source-linked object cases and research hubs.
milestones.next: Deepen original-language and household case studies; verify evidence and historical attribution.

milestones.title: The Middle Assyrian world and everyday life
milestones.delivered: Nine substantive studies cover Middle Assyrian law, families, farming, labour, worship and administration, with tablet references and consistent light/dark card styling.
milestones.next: Add dated legal and household cases with original line references and reviewed readings.

milestones.title: Readable, substantive encyclopaedia articles
milestones.delivered: Completed the 122-article editorial review: 106 articles expanded, 16 retained with reasons. Restored full, labelled citation boxes and pinpoint references.
milestones.next: Maintain explanatory depth and revisit short sections as new source evidence becomes available.

milestones.title: Individual tablet studies and archaeological case files
milestones.delivered: Nine object studies, 36 section-level source trails, short credited transcriptions and a searchable object concordance.
milestones.next: Verify editions and findspots; add object-level links only when independently supported.

milestones.title: Ancient texts and translation comparisons
milestones.delivered: Ancient-text comparison room with 16 credited excerpts from seven edited tablets; uncertain or unavailable readings remain explicit.
milestones.next: Review transliterations and add documented alternative readings.

milestones.title: Ancient text concordance and cross-reference index
milestones.delivered: Searchable concordance with 25 entries, 32 source relationships and links to encyclopaedia and Biblical passages.
milestones.next: Add terms only after validating names, source editions and chronological context.

milestones.title: Ancient names and historical identity disambiguation
milestones.delivered: Eight evidence-scoped name/place dossiers and twelve linked reading routes, with explicit limits on historical identity claims.
milestones.next: Verify original language, chronology and geography before asserting identifications.

milestones.title: Chaldean Catholic affiliation and shared Assyrian heritage - source-critical identity history
milestones.delivered: Published source-critical church-naming and shared Assyrian heritage studies, distinguishing ancient Kaldu, modern church terms and unproven ancestry claims.
milestones.next: Check original naming documents and primary inscriptions; strengthen independently sourced identity history.

milestones.title: Royal inscriptions and biblical cross-verification
milestones.delivered: Six royal inscription and Biblical comparisons with exact edition or object references; unresolved numerical differences remain visible.
milestones.next: Review royal readings and chronology before adding new reigns or resolving apparent conflicts.

milestones.title: The Fall of Samaria and Assyrian succession
milestones.delivered: Four-phase Samaria research room covering the succession, siege, conquest accounts, deportations and resettlement, with eight source-scoped comparisons.
milestones.next: Check damaged royal lines, deportation figures and Biblical chronology before refining maps.

milestones.title: Exile, resettlement and life in Assyrian provinces
milestones.delivered: Twelve comparisons covering deportations, resettlement, provincial letters and archaeology, supported by seventeen Biblical reading routes.
milestones.next: Verify original tablet readings and historical destinations before mapping migration routes.

milestones.title: Interactive historical atlas
milestones.delivered: Interactive, locally hosted historical atlas with eleven dated stages, timeline playback and documented reconstruction limits.
milestones.next: Improve boundary evidence and test mobile, keyboard and reduced-motion behaviour.

milestones.title: Section-level source traceability
milestones.delivered: Evidence register and 379 section-level trails, plus indexed object-line, article and Biblical cross-references.
milestones.next: Maintain source roles and verify passage-level links as articles evolve.

milestones.title: Historical claim verification
milestones.delivered: Maintained 91 anchored claim reviews with edition, Biblical reference and uncertainty checks.
milestones.next: Prioritise outstanding claims; automated traceability is not scholarly agreement.

milestones.title: Assyrian languages and cultural heritage
milestones.delivered: Eight language guides, Syriac Unicode reference room, manuscript and dialect resources, and cited cuneiform reading examples.
milestones.next: Verify original-language readings and add documented local dialect materials.

milestones.title: Community testimony and heritage media
milestones.delivered: Oral-history research room, ten attributed community records, six guides and three planning worksheets; no private submissions collected.
milestones.next: Establish consent, privacy and secure custody before accepting testimony or recordings.

milestones.title: Secure contribution delivery
milestones.delivered: Public contribution templates remain available; the private submission backend is inactive.
milestones.next: Provide a secure staffed delivery channel before accepting personal material.

milestones.title: Editorial governance and revision history
milestones.delivered: Published editorial standards, corrections policy and verifiable release history linked to GitHub merges.
milestones.next: Record substantive releases and corrections; review accessibility and source limitations.

milestones.title: Source integrity and accessibility audit
milestones.delivered: Automated source-link, markup, keyboard and reduced-motion audits, including bounded monthly URL-health checks.
milestones.next: Review inconclusive URLs and complete real-device and screen-reader assessments.

milestones.title: Source-credited images and multimedia across the encyclopaedia
milestones.delivered: Locally hosted, credited archive images with integrity checks and media-relevance triage; unrelated illustrations were removed or corrected.
milestones.next: Verify source licences and historical relevance; add media only where genuinely appropriate.

milestones.title: Publication and long-term stewardship
milestones.delivered: Deterministic preservation manifest, tested ZIP exports, restore checks and deployment integrity safeguards.
milestones.next: Arrange offsite backups, restoration drills and remaining publication-rights checks.

milestones.title: Assyrian persecution map and source catalogue
milestones.delivered: 198 attributed records across nine countries, including 16 village land-claim dossiers and a 69-source audit register with an interactive map.
milestones.next: Audit older cases, verify land deeds and restitution rulings, and expand independent source coverage beyond the 2019 village annex.
